assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-map art production reference, island overview for Blessed Are Those Who Sleep.
Primary request: Paint a polished north-up illustrated topographic island map using the supplied reference as the authoritative coastline and relief silhouette. Retain its narrow south tip, elongated north-south volcanic island (about 1.9 by 3.2 km), large inland caldera, steep coastal cliffs, highest southwest crater rim. A dark turquoise crater lake with tiny islets sits in the caldera. Academy buildings must remain SMALL, ONLY on the low flat southern lava terrace, about the footprint shown in the reference, with a small quay on the east side of that southern terrace. No other villages, no airport.
Style: carefully hand-painted cartographic game illustration, fine readable terrain shapes, subtle contour lines, mossy grass terraces, exposed basalt cliffs, sea foam, muted Atlantic blue sea. High view approaching orthographic north-up, portrait 2:3 composition, whole island surrounded by water, clean unornamented margins. Light from southwest. Academy late-1890s stone/lime buildings, modest terracotta roofs and small oxidized copper dome, no fantasy giant castle. Show cedar windbreak belts, irregular dry-stone pasture walls on low slopes, sparse hydrangeas only near academy. No characters, no compass text, no labels, no watermark, no decorative UI. This is an art reference rather than a survey or runtime tile texture; do not change geographic silhouette to prettify it. Reference is geometry input, not style.
assets.status: painted material/geography reference; not DEM-derived raster

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: academy map optimization art, accurate site-structure illustration.
Paint a detailed landscape north-up near-orthographic three-quarter architectural bird's-eye view of the existing island academy. Image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE campus plan: retain the building footprints, spacing, path topology and directions exactly. Image 2 shows the life-wing volume: retain tall north-south central living hall, four SINGLE-STORY sleeping blocks (two west and two east), TWO open-air transverse gravel lanes between each north/south pair, south bath annex. It is NOT a courtyard castle.
Map focus the entire enclosure and east harbor edge, no adjacent whole volcano. Late1890–1910 maritime academy on gently rising southern lava terrace, main axis bearing 2 degrees north: from SOUTH bottom to NORTH top: gatehouse, 24x30m stepped oath court, avenue, round 24m central hall with green copper dome and four porches, uphill 16x20m archive behind. Life wing 54.8x35.4m to WEST of avenue, logistics 28x20m plus small granary EAST. Lecture hall west of central hall. Stellar institute farther west. White tower institute/clinic east. Glasshouse and spring farther east uphill; ironworks southeast beside port road. Enclosure basalt wall with exactly one gate at south. Harbor outside wall to EAST and a small quay. Gate-to-harbor road follows southern edge and descends a switchback with visible rockfall before quay.
Style: restrained richly painted architectural game map, crisp readable roof silhouettes and footpaths, natural realistic proportions, no oversized towers. White lime/basalt cornerstones and terra-cotta roofs for domestic buildings; basalt/slate research buildings; rough stone lecture hall/gatehouse; central green copper dome. All sit on stepped stone foundations aligned to slope. Sun from southwest, soft short cast shadows; surrounding Atlantic blue, grass, cedar windbreaks, hydrangeas along enclosure, dry-stone field walls. 3:2 landscape. No text, labels, legend, rune circles, characters, watermark, modern elements. No underground secrets shown. Do not invent buildings or change site into symmetric fort. Geometry and paths must follow plan, illustration is NOT a technical survey.
assets.status: painted material/site reference; exact path lengths, blocked road and footprints not certified

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: life-wing structural detail illustration for game map art production.
Paint a landscape architectural structural-detail sheet with THREE clear panels, matching supplied life-wing massing reference (reference only, ignore lettering). Main large left panel (~two-thirds width): north-up high bird's-eye CUTAWAY of the single-story living wing. Central taller north-south living hall with clerestory windows, partial central roof kept to demonstrate height. Four separate low sleeping blocks, two WEST and two EAST. Open-air east-west gravel lane separates north and south blocks on EACH side, never roof over either lane. South bath annex. Show each sleeping block with central corridor and exactly SIX bedrooms in two rows of three, with beds, small desks, four lived-in rooms and two dust-sheet beds. At end adjoining central hall each block has small vestibule with isolation door, adjacent tiny toilet/storage, followed by common room with brass speaking tube and prep room then bedroom corridor. Roofs partly lifted to expose layout. No cloister court, no second floor.
Top right detail panel: section through tall central hall and adjoining lower red-tiled roof, show clerestory light, basalt foundation stepped on slope, lime wall/basalt cornerstones, gutter and rain pipe. Bottom right panel: a closer doorway vignette showing wooden self-closing isolation door, bronze pulley/counterweight, inside sliding bolt, peephole, copper acoustic tube wall joint, lamp and a small wooden wedge resting nearby.
Historical 1890–1910 Atlantic island academy, domestic practical timber/stone/terracotta/copper, no magic symbols or modern systems, no characters. Fine hand-painted architectural drawing, crisp clean contours, muted warm linen and honey oak interiors contrasted with dark basalt, muted blue-green surrounds, small-scale game environment reference. Southwest daylight, restrained warm lamps. Clean neutral pale background separating panels. No labels, no written text, no watermark, no dimensions or ruler numbers. This is material/detail art reference rather than guaranteed dimensional construction drawing.
assets.status: material and section study; generated bedroom subdivisions deviate from six rooms per zone; precise layout is in living_wing_plan_native_v1
